design.analysis_amendment: amendment.md: failed, rejected and partial terminal outcomes retain all measured consumption; usage completeness is independent of task success
design.arm_A: Fixed Sol medium baseline with full source context
design.arm_B: Bounded CIDM source-selection and review prototype with the same Sol medium worker; every Jev and worker call included
design.cidm_scope: Jev selects source context and reviews candidates, with bounded retry; not a full adaptive recursive multi-model graph
design.gate_calibration: Declared heuristics and uncalibrated self-assessments; no thresholds fitted to the evaluation results
design.quality_endpoint: Independent task pass on candidate actually released to the user; withheld or missing candidates score zero
design.token_definition: Provider total when supplied, otherwise input plus output; reasoning is a subset of output and cached input a subset of input
design.cost_definition: Explicit recorded billing cost only; no inferred prices or assumption that null costs are zero
design.controller: Deterministic Python; no hidden host-model generation during the measured pilot
design.excluded_creation_overhead: Dataset, harness, analysis and prompt creation overhead is unmetered and separate from recorded runtime
design.claims_scope: Bounded offline-analyzed pilot; no full-lifecycle efficiency, population superiority, or quality-equivalence claim

token_savings.scope: Empirical fixed-pilot estimate. A narrow or degenerate CI does not guarantee generalization.
